{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.hasseDeriv_comp",
      "informal_name": "Hasse Derivative Composition Formula with Binomial Coefficient",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k l : ℕ),\n  Polynomial.hasseDeriv k ∘ₗ Polynomial.hasseDeriv l = (k + l).choose k • Polynomial.hasseDeriv (k + l)",
      "informal_description": "For any semiring $ R $ and natural numbers $ k, l $, the composition of the $ k $-th and $ l $-th Hasse derivatives on the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ equals $ \\binom{k + l}{k} $ times the $ (k + l) $-th Hasse derivative, i.e., $ D^{(k)} \\circ D^{(l)} = \\binom{k + l}{k} D^{(k + l)} $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv_comp",
      "informal_name": "Composition of Hasse Derivatives on Laurent Series",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V] (k l : ℕ)\n  (f : LaurentSeries V),\n  (LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R k) ((LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R l) f) =\n    (k + l).choose k • (LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R (k + l)) f",
      "informal_description": "For any natural numbers $k$ and $l$, and any Laurent series $f$ with coefficients in an $R$-module $V$, the composition of the Hasse derivatives of orders $k$ and $l$ applied to $f$ equals $\\binom{k + l}{k} \\cdot \\text{hasseDeriv}_{k + l}(f)$, where $\\text{hasseDeriv}_n(f)$ denotes the Hasse derivative of order $n$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.RingTheory.LaurentSeries"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv_comp_coeff",
      "informal_name": "Composition of Hasse Derivatives and Binomial Coefficients in Laurent Series",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V] (k l : ℕ)\n  (f : LaurentSeries V) (n : ℤ),\n  ((LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R k) ((LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R l) f)).coeff n =\n    ((k + l).choose k • (LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R (k + l)) f).coeff n",
      "informal_description": "For any natural numbers $k, l$ and Laurent series $f$ with coefficients in an $R$-module $V$, the composition of the $k$-th and $l$-th Hasse derivatives satisfies $\\text{hasseDeriv}_k(\\text{hasseDeriv}_l f) = \\binom{k + l}{k} \\cdot \\text{hasseDeriv}_{k + l} f$. Specifically, for any integer exponent $n$, the coefficient of $n$ in the composed derivative equals $\\binom{k + l}{k}$ multiplied by the coefficient of $n$ in the $(k + l)$-th Hasse derivative of $f$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.RingTheory.LaurentSeries"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.factorial_smul_hasseDeriv",
      "informal_name": "Factorial Scaling of Hasse Derivative Equals Iterated Derivative",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ), ⇑(k.factorial • Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) = (⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k]",
      "informal_description": "For any semiring $ R $, the $ k $-th Hasse derivative operator on the polynomial ring $ R[X] $, when multiplied by $ k! $, equals the $ k $-th iterate of the standard derivative operator. Formally, $ k! \\cdot D^{(k)} = (\\frac{d}{dX})^k $, where $ D^{(k)} $ denotes the Hasse derivative of order $ k $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.hasseDeriv_coeff",
      "informal_name": "Coefficient Formula for Hasse Derivative of Order k",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),\n  ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f).coeff n = ↑((n + k).choose k) * f.coeff (n + k)",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $ n $, the coefficient of $ X^n $ in the $ k $-th Hasse derivative of a polynomial $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ is equal to $ \\binom{n + k}{k} $ multiplied by the coefficient of $ X^{n + k} $ in $ f $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv"
    }
  ]
}

items.informal_name: Hasse Derivative Composition Formula with Binomial Coefficient
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k l : ℕ),
  Polynomial.hasseDeriv k ∘ₗ Polynomial.hasseDeriv l = (k + l).choose k • Polynomial.hasseDeriv (k + l)
items.informal_description: For any semiring $ R $ and natural numbers $ k, l $, the composition of the $ k $-th and $ l $-th Hasse derivatives on the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ equals $ \binom{k + l}{k} $ times the $ (k + l) $-th Hasse derivative, i.e., $ D^{(k)} \circ D^{(l)} = \binom{k + l}{k} D^{(k + l)} $.

items.informal_name: Composition of Hasse Derivatives on Laurent Series
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V] (k l : ℕ)
  (f : LaurentSeries V),
  (LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R k) ((LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R l) f) =
    (k + l).choose k • (LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R (k + l)) f
items.informal_description: For any natural numbers $k$ and $l$, and any Laurent series $f$ with coefficients in an $R$-module $V$, the composition of the Hasse derivatives of orders $k$ and $l$ applied to $f$ equals $\binom{k + l}{k} \cdot \text{hasseDeriv}_{k + l}(f)$, where $\text{hasseDeriv}_n(f)$ denotes the Hasse derivative of order $n$.

items.informal_name: Composition of Hasse Derivatives and Binomial Coefficients in Laurent Series
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V] (k l : ℕ)
  (f : LaurentSeries V) (n : ℤ),
  ((LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R k) ((LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R l) f)).coeff n =
    ((k + l).choose k • (LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R (k + l)) f).coeff n
items.informal_description: For any natural numbers $k, l$ and Laurent series $f$ with coefficients in an $R$-module $V$, the composition of the $k$-th and $l$-th Hasse derivatives satisfies $\text{hasseDeriv}_k(\text{hasseDeriv}_l f) = \binom{k + l}{k} \cdot \text{hasseDeriv}_{k + l} f$. Specifically, for any integer exponent $n$, the coefficient of $n$ in the composed derivative equals $\binom{k + l}{k}$ multiplied by the coefficient of $n$ in the $(k + l)$-th Hasse derivative of $f$.

items.informal_name: Factorial Scaling of Hasse Derivative Equals Iterated Derivative
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ), ⇑(k.factorial • Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) = (⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k]
items.informal_description: For any semiring $ R $, the $ k $-th Hasse derivative operator on the polynomial ring $ R[X] $, when multiplied by $ k! $, equals the $ k $-th iterate of the standard derivative operator. Formally, $ k! \cdot D^{(k)} = (\frac{d}{dX})^k $, where $ D^{(k)} $ denotes the Hasse derivative of order $ k $.

items.informal_name: Coefficient Formula for Hasse Derivative of Order k
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f).coeff n = ↑((n + k).choose k) * f.coeff (n + k)
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $, the coefficient of $ X^n $ in the $ k $-th Hasse derivative of a polynomial $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ is equal to $ \binom{n + k}{k} $ multiplied by the coefficient of $ X^{n + k} $ in $ f $.
